2026-05-19T06:41:19.4078175Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Closes the silent-drift bug surfaced by **shubhodeep1/binance-blessings#135**, where the orchestrator declared a project complete + validated while the default branch was N PRs behind the integration branch. Three interacting defects were involved; this PR lands fixes for all three plus end-to-end regression tests.

**The trigger.** `review_autofix.yml`'s "Enable auto-merge on PR" step had a scoped opt-out only for the `e2e-smoke-test` label. When the integration-conflict self-healing path (`_dispatch_review_for_conflicts`) dispatched `review_autofix` against the eager final PR to resolve drift, convergence triggered `gh pr merge --squash --auto`, shipping the integration branch partway through the project.

**The amplifier.** `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` early-returned whenever the state's `final_merge_status` was already `"merged"` — even after the integration branch drifted ahead of default due to the early auto-merge. The pin became permanent: `mark_validation_complete` then set `status=complete` + `ai:validated` against a stale default branch.

**The blind spot.** `cmd_check_wave_status` defined `project_complete` purely from wave-issue merge state into the integration branch. The judge's clean-completion-skip path and the validation dispatcher both consumed `PROJECT_COMPLETE` without comparing against the default branch.

## Fixes

| # | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 (highest leverage) | `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` | `finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` now re-checks `ahead_by` before both early-returns (the pinned-`merged` path and the recorded-PR closed+merged re-discovery path). On `ahead_by > 0`, the pin is cleared and the function falls through to recreate the final PR. Fail-closed on compare-API error. |
| 1 | `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` | Auto-merg

2026-05-18T17:13:53.3126325Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Fixes #2734 — wave 2 dispatch on `orchestrator/project-2734` blocked because the integration branch HEAD violated the merged sub-issue fingerprint contract.

**Root cause** (commit-level): `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` ran minutes after PR #2738 merged Phase 1A baseline/delta into `scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py` (merge commit `e67f0f7`). The [ai-maint] refresh saw a per-file hash drift between the post-merge integration tip and main, force-checked-out main's older version (commit `026cfa7`), and pushed — silently reverting PR #2738. The post-resolve merged sub-issue fingerprint verifier then flagged the regressed `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` patterns (Workflow run [26040740781](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/actions/runs/26040740781) annotations) and the orchestrator refused to dispatch wave 2.

**Fix**: before the per-file refresh loop, resolve the merge-base of `integration_branch` vs `default_branch` once. For each allowlisted file, compute its hash at the merge-base. When the integration-branch hash differs from the merge-base hash, the integration branch has its own committed changes to the file since the branches diverged (typically from a merged sub-issue's PR) — skip the refresh for that file and let the normal `default_branch -> integration_branch` sync handle 3-way merge. The deadlock-breaking path (integration unchanged, main has a toolchain fix) is preserved unchanged. Fail-open: missing merge-base falls through to the legacy hash-only comparison.

## Files changed

- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` — added merge-base divergence guard inside `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling` (3289-3352).

2026-05-18T15:54:22.1279213Z   pr_body: ## Summary

Fixes #2734 — wave 2 dispatch on `orchestrator/project-2734` blocked because the integration branch HEAD violated the merged sub-issue fingerprint contract.

**Root cause** (commit-level): `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` ran minutes after PR #2738 merged Phase 1A baseline/delta into `scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py` (merge commit `e67f0f7`). The [ai-maint] refresh saw a per-file hash drift between the post-merge integration tip and main, force-checked-out main's older version (commit `026cfa7`), and pushed — silently reverting PR #2738. The post-resolve merged sub-issue fingerprint verifier then flagged the regressed `must_contain` / `must_not_contain` patterns (Workflow run [26040740781](https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/actions/runs/26040740781) annotations) and the orchestrator refused to dispatch wave 2.

**Fix**: before the per-file refresh loop, resolve the merge-base of `integration_branch` vs `default_branch` once. For each allowlisted file, compute its hash at the merge-base. When the integration-branch hash differs from the merge-base hash, the integration branch has its own committed changes to the file since the branches diverged (typically from a merged sub-issue's PR) — skip the refresh for that file and let the normal `default_branch -> integration_branch` sync handle 3-way merge. The deadlock-breaking path (integration unchanged, main has a toolchain fix) is preserved unchanged. Fail-open: missing merge-base falls through to the legacy hash-only comparison.

## Files changed

- `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` — added merge-base divergence guard inside `_refresh_integration_resolver_tooling` (3289-3352).
